title: Deno's Wonder Wheel Amusement Park
specs: World famous NYC Landmark Deno's Wonder Wheel
Must be 36" to ride Samba, Pony Carts, Dizzy Dragons, Sea Serpent Roller Coaster, Jump Around, Fire Engines, Big Trucks, Jets
Must be 30" to ride Fire Engines, Carousel, Jumping Motorcycles
Must be 42" to ride Dizzy Dragons
Must be 36" minimum and 55" maximum to ride Boats and Carousel
Must be 38" to ride Jets alone and 36" to ride with an adult
Must be 46" to ride Rio Grande Train alone and 36" to ride with an adult
Groups of 25 or more welcome including church groups, schools, temples, yeshivas, day camps
Group Booking Manager Joann available for assistance

blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of adult and kiddie rides including the world famous Deno's Wonder Wheel. The park offers credits for rides that can be purchased in different amounts. The Kiddie Park has multiple rides with specific height requirements.
extraNote: Located on the Boardwalk at Denos Vourderis Place (formerly W. 12th St.) between Nathan's Famous Hot Dog Restaurant and the New York Aquarium.
